title: On a phone, the record header title and the record path labels run off the right edge with no wrap or ellipsis
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 3 Service (report comment 6444034183 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D2; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-97u09k` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/3-service/`); track 2 Revenue (report comment 6444188882 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding S22; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-urevq9` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/2-revenue/`); track 4 Marketing (report comment 6444160853 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding S19; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-f5gugw` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/4-marketing/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

At 390×844: CASE-00001 reads "CASE-00001 · Login issues after platfo", KA-0025 reads "KA-0025 - QA 2320 — Fixing a stuck i", and the path labels are cut ("Resolu") (`phone-04-case-record.png`, `phone-07-kb-article.png`). The same on a campaign and on quotes. On desktop the header ellipsises ("CASE-00001 · Login issues after platform …").

**Who loses:** on a phone the user cannot read which record they are on.

## Expected

The header title wraps (or ellipsises, as on desktop), and path labels fit or ellipsise.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "record page header title overflow phone no ellipsis path labels cut": 4 hits — #25897 (closed, read-mode field values truncate instead of wrapping on desktop), #25895 (closed, path squeezes two terminal stages), #22536, #4358 (closed). None is the header title or path labels at phone width.

**Reader who acts:** the console `page:header` / `record:path` owner.
